source_text: 1.1 "Agreement" means this Master Service Agreement, including all exhibits, schedules, and amendments hereto. 1.2 "Confidential Information" means any non-public information disclosed by either Party, whether orally or in writing, that is designated as confidential. 1.3 "Services" means the professional services described in Section 2.1 and any applicable Statement of Work.
display_text:
[DEFINITIONS]
1.1 "Agreement" means this Master Service Agreement, including all exhibits, schedules, and amendments hereto. 1.2 "Confidential Information" means any non-public information disclosed by either Party, whether orally or in writing, that is designated as confidential. 1.3 "Services" means the professional services described in Section 2.1 and any applicable Statement of Work.

source_text: The Vendor shall provide the Services described in each Statement of Work executed under this Agreement. Vendor shall perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.
display_text:
[SCOPE OF SERVICES > Description of Services]
The Vendor shall provide the Services described in each Statement of Work executed under this Agreement. Vendor shall perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

source_text: Any material change to the scope of Services must be documented in a written change order signed by both Parties, subject to the fee adjustments in Section 4.3.
display_text:
[SCOPE OF SERVICES > Change Orders]
Any material change to the scope of Services must be documented in a written change order signed by both Parties, subject to the fee adjustments in Section 4.3.

source_text: Client shall pay all invoiced amounts within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Late payments shall accrue interest at 1.5% per month, subject to Section 3.4.
display_text:
[FEES AND PAYMENT > Payment Obligations]
Client shall pay all invoiced amounts within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Late payments shall accrue interest at 1.5% per month, subject to Section 3.4.

source_text: All fees are exclusive of applicable taxes, which shall be borne by Client except taxes based on Vendor's net income.
display_text:
[FEES AND PAYMENT > Taxes]
All fees are exclusive of applicable taxes, which shall be borne by Client except taxes based on Vendor's net income.

source_text: Client may withhold payment of a disputed amount only if it provides written notice of the dispute within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date, as further described in Section 6.2 (Notice Requirements).
display_text:
[FEES AND PAYMENT > Disputed Invoices]
Client may withhold payment of a disputed amount only if it provides written notice of the dispute within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date, as further described in Section 6.2 (Notice Requirements).

source_text: This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twenty-four (24) months, unless earlier terminated as set forth in this Section 4.
display_text:
[TERM AND TERMINATION > Term]
This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twenty-four (24) months, unless earlier terminated as set forth in this Section 4.

source_text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice if the other Party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days of receiving notice, subject to the notice requirements in Section 6.2. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client may terminate immediately for Vendor's failure to maintain the insurance required under Section 8.1.
display_text:
[TERM AND TERMINATION > Termination for Cause]
Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice if the other Party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days of receiving notice, subject to the notice requirements in Section 6.2. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client may terminate immediately for Vendor's failure to maintain the insurance required under Section 8.1.

source_text: No cure period shall apply to breaches of the confidentiality obligations in Section 7 or to a Party's insolvency, which shall each constitute grounds for immediate termination.
display_text:
[TERM AND TERMINATION > Termination for Cause > Cure Period Exceptions]
No cure period shall apply to breaches of the confidentiality obligations in Section 7 or to a Party's insolvency, which shall each constitute grounds for immediate termination.

source_text: Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice. In the event of termination for convenience, Client shall pay Vendor for all Services performed through the effective date of termination, together with any non-cancellable costs reasonably incurred, but shall not be liable for lost profits.
display_text:
[TERM AND TERMINATION > Termination for Convenience]
Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice. In the event of termination for convenience, Client shall pay Vendor for all Services performed through the effective date of termination, together with any non-cancellable costs reasonably incurred, but shall not be liable for lost profits.

source_text: Upon termination for any reason: (a) Client shall pay all outstanding fees for Services rendered prior to termination; (b) each Party shall return or destroy the other Party's Confidential Information; and (c) Sections 3, 5, 7, and 9 shall survive termination.
display_text:
[TERM AND TERMINATION > Effect of Termination]
Upon termination for any reason: (a) Client shall pay all outstanding fees for Services rendered prior to termination; (b) each Party shall return or destroy the other Party's Confidential Information; and (c) Sections 3, 5, 7, and 9 shall survive termination.

source_text: 5.1 EXCEPT FOR BREACHES OF SECTION 7 (CONFIDENTIALITY), NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. EACH PARTY'S TOTAL LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
display_text:
[LIMITATION OF LIABILITY]
5.1 EXCEPT FOR BREACHES OF SECTION 7 (CONFIDENTIALITY), NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. EACH PARTY'S TOTAL LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

source_text: All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by email with confirmation of receipt, or by certified mail.
display_text:
[NOTICES > Method of Notice]
All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by email with confirmation of receipt, or by certified mail.

source_text: Notices relating to termination or disputed invoices must reference the specific section of this Agreement giving rise to the notice and must be sent to the address designated in the applicable Statement of Work.
display_text:
[NOTICES > Notice Requirements]
Notices relating to termination or disputed invoices must reference the specific section of this Agreement giving rise to the notice and must be sent to the address designated in the applicable Statement of Work.

source_text: 7.1 Each Party agrees to protect the other Party's Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information, and in no event less than reasonable care. 7.2 The obligations of this Section 7 shall survive termination of this Agreement for a period of five (5) years, as referenced in Section 4.4(c).
display_text:
[CONFIDENTIALITY]
7.1 Each Party agrees to protect the other Party's Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own confidential information, and in no event less than reasonable care. 7.2 The obligations of this Section 7 shall survive termination of this Agreement for a period of five (5) years, as referenced in Section 4.4(c).

source_text: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence throughout the Term.
display_text:
[INSURANCE AND INDEMNIFICATION > Insurance]
Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence throughout the Term.

source_text: Vendor shall indemnify Client against third-party claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or willful misconduct in performing the Services, subject to the limitation of liability in Section 5.1.
display_text:
[INSURANCE AND INDEMNIFICATION > Indemnification]
Vendor shall indemnify Client against third-party claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or willful misconduct in performing the Services, subject to the limitation of liability in Section 5.1.
